title: AI Advancement Undermines Funding for Professional Journalism in Brazil
seoTitle: AI eats away at newspaper revenue in Brazil
subtitle: Search engine summaries reduce direct traffic to news sites, harming their financial sustainability
excerpt: The rise of AI in search engines has lowered direct access to news portals, affecting the revenue that sustains professional journalism in the country.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) through the summaries that search engines provide online has been eroding direct traffic to news sites, undermining the financing of professional journalism in Brazil.

How search engine summaries change the reader flow

Search engines, by presenting AI‑generated concise answers, allow users to obtain the main information without having to click on the source site’s link. This model reduces the need for direct access to news portals, decreasing the number of visits that were previously recorded on the publishers’ servers.

Impact on journalism’s funding model

The bulk of digital media revenue comes from advertising and subscriptions, both tied to traffic volume. When visitor numbers drop, advertisers tend to cut spending, and the subscriber base can stagnate or decline. Thus, the reduction in direct traffic caused by AI summaries jeopardizes the financial sustainability of newsrooms that rely on these resources to produce professional journalistic content.

Challenges and outlook for the sector

With the trend of AI systems expanding in search engines, professional journalism faces the need to rethink audience acquisition and monetisation strategies. While summaries continue to offer convenience to users, pressure on traditional funding models increases, demanding adaptations that preserve the production of quality news.

With information from Agência Brasil.
